query: daily_revenue dropped 40% overnight. marketing_spend looks broken too — it is two days stale, lost 88% of its rows, and had a column renamed this morning. Is that the cause?
expected_behavior: Does NOT accept marketing_spend on the strength of its anomaly signals alone, even though they are the strongest in the graph

Reports that no lineage path connects marketing_spend to daily_revenue, and rejects it explicitly rather than dropping it silently
Continues down the ranked candidate list instead of stopping at the rejection
Explains the distinction to the user: a ranking is a hypothesis, a reconstructed path is proof
If a grounded cause is found, reports it with its proof path; if not, escalates to a human and writes nothing
